blocks.text: Take your listening experience to the next level with wireless Bluetooth headphones built for sports, workouts, travel, and everyday use. Designed for people on the move, they deliver up to 80 hours of total playtime so you can enjoy uninterrupted music through long days, trips, and training sessions. The pocket-sized charging case features a dual LED display showing the case’s battery percentage and the earbuds’ charging progress, giving you clear power management at a glance. Each earbud offers up to 8 hours of playtime per charge, and by alternating earbuds, you can stay powered for days.

Enjoy rich, balanced stereo sound powered by 10mm dynamic drivers that produce crisp highs, detailed mids, and deep bass. Whether you are running, working out, watching movies, gaming, or streaming podcasts, you’ll appreciate the consistent clarity. Dual built-in microphones capture your voice clearly, reducing background noise for smooth calls, whether you’re commuting, outdoors, or working remotely.

Connectivity is quick and stable thanks to the latest Bluetooth technology, which provides fast pairing and low-latency transmission for a seamless experience. Once paired, the earbuds automatically reconnect to your last device. Unlike sensitive touch controls, these earbuds use separate main and volume buttons, giving you simple, responsive control over music, calls, and volume without accidental interruptions.

Comfort and stability are essential for active users. The ergonomic over-ear hooks and three pairs of soft silicone tips (S/M/L) create a secure, customized fit for different ear shapes. The acoustic seal improves sound and keeps the earbuds stable during running, cycling, and gym workouts.
Built for an active lifestyle, these earbuds are sweat- and dust-resistant and come with a compact case that prevents loss and keeps them ready wherever you go.

items.label: AI Real Time Translation Earbuds in 165 Languages
items.value: These translator earbuds are powered by three leading AI models, supporting 165 languages across 95% of global regions with 95 localized accents, delivering a 0.2s response and over 98% translation accuracy for low-latency, high-precision real-time translation. Translating earbuds real time ensures confident and effortless communication in any scenario, from business calls and online conferences to study sessions and casual conversations.

items.label: 9 Functions & 5 Translation Modes
items.value: These translation earbuds real time are fully unlocked after activation, giving you access to all translation features and the app with no subscription or extra fees. The language translator earbuds support five modes: Free Talk, Headphone + Phone, Audio/Video Call, Photo Translation, and Translation Machine, ideal for travel, learning, and meetings. All 9 functions are free, with regular app updates for more languages and higher accuracy.

items.label: 80H Battery Life & Dual Digital Display
items.value: These AI translation earbuds real time deliver up to 80 hours of total playback with the charging case, supporting long use for music, travel, and real-time translation in meetings. Powerful features need powerful battery life for truly uninterrupted performance. The audifonos traductores inglés español charging case is equipped with a digital display showing the remaining battery for both earbuds and case, keeping you informed and confident at all times.

items.label: Directional Mic + 4-Way Smart Translation Tunnel
items.value: The upgraded directional microphones with 4-way tunnel technology capture speech with over 99% accuracy, enabling audifonos traductores for precise real-time translation. Even in noisy environments like streets, meetings, or airports, speech is accurately recognized for clear translations and calls. Auriculares traductores de idiomas are ideal for travel, work, and long sessions.

items.label: 4-in-1 Smart Earbuds & Wide Compatibility
items.value: These translating earbuds combine real-time translation, AI chat, high-quality sound, and HD calls, while supporting practical features like simultaneous translation, video calls, and face-to-face chat. Rigid composite diaphragms and directional microphones deliver immersive stereo sound, and AI translation headphones let you enjoy technology and modern lifestyle during travel, learning, or social activities. Compatible with phones, tablets, and laptops
